deck: US proposes tariffs on 14 economies · AI chip rout sinks Seoul 6.2% · Pakistan's first astronaut docks at China's station · 31 die in Cairo tanker fire

numbers.t: economies in new US tariff plan
Kospi, worst day in AI sell-off
UK energy price cap from January

leads.headline: US proposes tariffs on 14 economies, China to EU
leads.dek: China up to 20%, 15% on the EU, up to 15% on Japan and Korea, up to 35% on Vietnam. Hearings from 25 Jan; nothing in force yet.
leads.why: Allies and rivals alike face higher US duties

leads.headline: AI chip rout: Seoul's Kospi crashes 6.2%
leads.dek: Kospi closes at 4,697.51; Samsung −9.9%, SK hynix −11.1%. Nikkei −2.8% (SoftBank −15%), Taiwan about −5%.
leads.why: Doubts grow that AI spending will pay off

leads.headline: Pakistan's first astronaut docks at China's station
leads.dek: Shenzhou-24 lifts off 00:18 UTC, docks 03:56 UTC. Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, 40, is Tiangong's first foreign visitor.
leads.why: China opens its station to other nations

stories.headline: Tanker fire on Cairo ring road kills 31
stories.dek: Fuel tanker blaze on the Ring Road; 21 injured, health ministry says.

stories.headline: Iran says two tankers hit mines
stories.dek: Both caught fire, says the IRGC; US tells citizens to leave Iran.

stories.headline: Houthis claim Ras Tanura refinery attack
stories.dek: Coalition says it destroyed missiles aimed at Riyadh; oil briefly up 2%.

stories.headline: UK energy cap to jump 26% in January
stories.dek: Typical bill £1,723 to £2,166 a year; £100 help for about 20m homes.

stories.headline: Storm pushes Macy's parade to Saturday
stories.dek: First weather delay in 100 years; gusts of 50–65 mph forecast.

stories.headline: Army blows up 5 tons of old lead azide
stories.dek: Controlled blast at ammunition plant; EPA reads zero airborne lead.

stories.headline: Troops free all 76 supermarket hostages
stories.dek: Colombian forces end the Cartagena siege; one captor killed.

stories.headline: Solomon Islands sign Australia pact
stories.dek: Australia is 'primary security partner'; no foreign bases.

stories.headline: Ukraine says it hit 5 jets at Russian airbase
stories.dek: Three MiG-31s and two Su-34s at Savasleyka airbase, east of Moscow.

stories.headline: Roma hold PSG 2–2; Lille stun Bayern
stories.dek: Roma end PSG's perfect run; Sporting 2–2 Man United.
